extraction.Name: Louise Waugh
extraction.Recorded patent: The receipt was signed by the allottee; the patent was recorded by McManigal on March 5, 1918
extraction.Buyer: Frank and Louise Waugh mortgaged to Royal Mutual Life Insurance Company for $2200 due March 23, 1923; mortgaged to F. Lewis and John F. Murphy for $3000 on May 13, 1921; Louise and Frank mortgaged to E. A. Petterson for $100; mortgaged to J. B. Smith for $4000 on May 1, 1922; conveyed to Mr. Petterson for $5400 subject to the $4000 mortgage on July 18, 1922
extraction.NOTES: Fee patent No. 612786; Southeast quarter section 30, township 99, north of range 74; Frank Waugh appears as co-mortgagor and co-grantor with Louise Waugh; in 1913 a Lis pendens was filed against the land by Joe Kirby, probably on account of the law suit the Sullys instituted against the United States to obtain their allotments, Louise Waugh being one of the Sullys; Royal Mutual Life Insurance Company mortgage released on June 15, 1921; McClough-Murphy mortgage released on June 19, 1922; patent recorded February 11, 1918
